description: Send an email from the line's own address (handle@cosvoice.com). Reply to a message the line received by passing reply_to_email_id (recipient and subject fill in, threading is kept), or write to the owner. The line may only email people who have emailed it first, its owner, or its Bot inbox. Plain text; keep it short and sign as the line.

reply_to_email_id.description: Id of a received email to reply to.
